resolution_notes: base_url: ORIGINAL is too generic. The official KYT reference names https://api.chainalysis.com/api/kyt as the production API endpoint; v1 and v2 are route versions beneath it. Evidence: https://kytdoc.kyt-dev.e.chainalysis.com/ . example: ORIGINAL root request is invalid, but the Token header is documented, not invented. The official reference documents GET /v1/assets with Token and Accept headers and the asset-list response used here. Evidence: https://kytdoc.kyt-dev.e.chainalysis.com/ .
